summary: DeepSeek published a changelog for an alpha release of its deepseek-harness developer tool, adding bidirectional parent-child agent messaging, UI refinements, and several breaking changes to session APIs and default tool exposure.

practices.reason: Bidirectional send_message between parent and continuable child agents replaces one-way reporting, changing how multi-agent task delegation and follow-up coordination would be built.
practices.quote: Let parent Agents and continuable child Agents exchange follow-up messages through `send_message`, replacing the one-way `report` tool

practices.reason: Session.events is removed in favor of on-demand read APIs, requiring any code that consumed the old event stream to be migrated.
practices.quote: Replace `Session.events` with on-demand read APIs: `seq`, `eventAt()`, and `snapshotEvents()` by @kermanx

practices.reason: The explicit strong-typing split between SessionSeq and SessionLogOffset is flagged as a compatibility concern developers must check.
practices.quote: Distinguish `SessionSeq` and `SessionLogOffset` with strong types; developers should should pay attention to compatibility

practices.reason: Removing the default general-purpose workflow tool from Web PTC Mode changes the tool surface available to existing integrations built on that default.
practices.quote: Stop exposing the general-purpose `workflow` tool by default in Web PTC Mode by @koalazf99

practices.reason: Enabling web_fetch by default across SDK, Headless, ACP and custom profiles changes the default capability surface teams need to account for.
practices.quote: Enable `web_fetch` by default for the Python SDK, Headless, ACP, and custom Profiles by @koalazf99
